description: 画一个通用GPU系统架构示意，表达任务如何被分发以及数据如何访问存储。Host通过Host Interface把任务交给Command Frontend，再由Thread Scheduler / Work Distributor分发到四个完全等价的Compute Clusters；每个Cluster都有相同的局部调度与执行资源、独立Private Register File和Private L1 Cache，展开一个代表Cluster说明内部组成，其余三个保留同构身份。四个Cluster的私有L1都访问同一个Shared L2，Shared L2通过Memory Interface访问片外Memory，要体现请求和数据返回；私有寄存器和L1不共享，Cluster之间不是串行流水。这个GPU是概念示意，必要的普通控制或协调细节可合理补全，不指定执行器数量、缓存容量、位宽、带宽或周期数。
style_prompt:
STYLE CONTRACT CPS5-paper-2a026e31fb
Keep this same visual system across every figure in the document.
Palette: background #FFFFFF; ink #263238; primary #EDF2F5; secondary #E8EEE8; muted #F7F8F9.
A compact publication figure on pure white, like an architecture-paper hardware diagram. No shadows, glow, depth, texture or gradients.
Geometry follows hardware role: shallow queue/register bars, tight compute rectangles, interfaces with aligned ports, taller banked memories only when supported by their specification. Do not use uniform square cards.
Use subdued blue-gray for compute and pale sage for storage; control and interfaces stay white. Color is sparse and follows role; at most three fill roles plus neutral gray.
One neutral sans-serif family, normal/medium-weight module names and regular signal labels. Thin dark data lines, slightly thinner gray dashed control lines, small arrowheads. Group titles are subordinate and boundaries do not create large empty panels.
For a 1600px-wide publication figure, start with main labels F=20–24px and signal labels 18–20px. Use normal/medium weight, not heavy bold billboard text. Widen or wrap exact names into two lines; never make a short name occupy a large padded card.
A small 3% white perimeter and compact signal corridors. Containers have very thin neutral outlines with little padding, never large empty blue frames. Solid fills only; no page texture. Use Noto Sans CJK / Microsoft YaHei-like sans-serif for Chinese.
Use narrow engineering strokes and small arrowheads; primary paths may be slightly stronger but never thick flowchart arrows. Labels sit in open gaps. A crossing without a dot is not a connection.
Use a concise legend only for conventions actually used. No ornamental page furniture.

spec.layout: Left-to-right system overview. Left column: g_host (n_host, n_hostif) then g_front (n_cmd) then g_sched (n_sched) as the task submission chain. Center: a vertical stack of four peer cluster groups — g_cluster0 at top as the representative expanded cluster containing n_ls0, n_exec0, n_rf0, n_l10; g_cluster1, g_cluster2, g_cluster3 below as compact peer blocks (n_c1, n_c2, n_c3) aligned to the same width. Right column: g_mem band with n_l2, n_memif, n_dram stacked top-to-bottom. Forward request edges run left-to-right; data-return edges route back along a lower corridor from g_mem to each cluster. Keep the four cluster groups visually identical in size to signal equivalence; no serial chain between clusters.
annotations: Cluster 0 is shown expanded as the representative; Clusters 1–3 are identical peers with the same internal resources.
Private Register File and Private L1 Cache are per-cluster and not shared; only Shared L2 is common.
Clusters operate in parallel, not as a serial pipeline.
assumptions: Command Frontend内部以Command Processor代表命令解析与排序，属通用示意补全。
Host Interface作为Host与GPU之间的任务提交边界，未指定协议与位宽。
Shared L2与Memory Interface之间的请求/返回路径为通用读写访问示意，未指定带宽、延迟或周期。
四个Cluster的私有L1到Shared L2的连接按每个Cluster独立请求/返回绘制，未指定互联拓扑细节。
执行器数量、缓存容量、位宽、带宽与周期数均未指定，图中不体现。
questions: 是否需要把Command Frontend内部进一步展开（如命令队列、同步/栅栏单元）？
是否需要补充Cluster内部的共享存储或线程块资源（如Shared Memory / Scratchpad）？
checks: 确认四个Cluster组在图中尺寸与样式一致，以体现“完全等价”。
确认私有Register File与L1未与其它Cluster相连，仅Shared L2为共享资源。
确认请求与数据返回两条方向均有体现，且未暗示Cluster间串行流水。
